name: MirrorFly Video Call API & SDK
description_en:
MirrorFly provides SDKs for embedding voice and video calls inside a customer-built application. It is a development and deployment purchase, distinct from signing up for a ready-made meeting link. Its official video URL now redirects to /video/.

Current commercial material emphasizes self-hosted, white-label infrastructure and a custom lifetime licence. The pricing table marks source-code access optional; access or customization language is not evidence of an open-source licence.
description_zh:
MirrorFly 提供在客户自建应用中嵌入语音和视频通话的 SDK，采购对象包含开发及部署，区别于注册即用的会议链接。其原视频网址现跳转至 /video/。

当前商业资料强调自托管、白标基础设施及定制终身许可。价格表将源码访问标为可选；可访问源码或定制不等于开源许可。

core_features.explanation_en: Documentation links Android, iOS, JavaScript, React, Angular, Flutter and React Native call SDK routes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档链接 Android、iOS、JavaScript、React、Angular、Flutter 及 React Native 通话 SDK。

core_features.explanation_en: The overview lists group calls, mute, call logs, missed-call alerts, meeting links and scheduling.
core_features.explanation_zh: 概览列出群组通话、静音、通话记录、未接提醒、会议链接及排期。

en: An application team chooses its client platform and an appropriate call SDK route, obtains the agreed licence and defines the calling workflow within its existing application. Prototype an outgoing call, an accepted call and a missed call, then verify mute, camera permission, reconnect behavior and notifications on the intended devices. These are evaluation steps, not an integration executed in this research.
zh: 应用团队选择客户端平台及相应通话 SDK，取得约定许可，并在现有应用中定义呼叫流程。应原型验证呼出、接听及未接，再在目标设备检查静音、相机权限、重连和通知。这些是评估步骤，本次没有执行集成。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

sections.title_en: Example: add calling to a customer-support application
sections.title_zh: 示例：为客户支持应用加入通话
sections.en:
An application team chooses its client platform and an appropriate call SDK route, obtains the agreed licence and defines the calling workflow within its existing application. Prototype an outgoing call, an accepted call and a missed call, then verify mute, camera permission, reconnect behavior and notifications on the intended devices. These are evaluation steps, not an integration executed in this research.

The documentation overview lists call logs and meeting links, but an overview does not establish initialization, identity mapping or access-control defaults. Read the selected platform’s quickstart and API reference before implementation; chat UIKit links on the same page are not automatically a complete video integration.
sections.zh:
应用团队选择客户端平台及相应通话 SDK，取得约定许可，并在现有应用中定义呼叫流程。应原型验证呼出、接听及未接，再在目标设备检查静音、相机权限、重连和通知。这些是评估步骤，本次没有执行集成。

文档概览列出通话记录和会议链接，但概览不能确立初始化、身份映射或访问控制默认值。实现前应阅读所选平台的快速指南及 API 参考；同页聊天 UIKit 链接不自动组成完整视频集成。

sections.title_en: A one-time licence is not a fixed total ownership cost
sections.title_zh: 一次许可费不等于固定总成本
sections.en:
The pricing page describes custom pricing and lifetime licensing billed once, with self-hosted deployment. It does not publish a numeric amount. Source-code access is optional in the table; recording and live streaming also have optional markings. Obtain a written offer for the exact voice/video SDKs, features, source rights, support, upgrades and deployment entitlement.

Hosting, bandwidth, monitoring, maintenance and application development still need an owner and budget. Marketing claims about unlimited use or cost savings do not establish measured capacity or savings for the buyer. No normalized monthly price or open-source licence is inferred.
sections.zh:
价格页说明定制报价、一次计费的终身许可以及自托管部署，没有公开数字金额。表格将源码访问标为可选，录制及直播也有可选标记。应就具体语音/视频 SDK、功能、源码权、支持、升级及部署权取得书面报价。

托管、带宽、监控、维护和应用开发仍需负责人及预算。不限使用或节省费用的营销主张不等于买家的实测容量或节约，不据此推算标准月费或开源许可。

sections.title_zh: 开发控制权伴随集成责任
sections.en:
Teams building an owned communications experience can evaluate a self-hosted SDK; nontechnical organizers wanting an immediately usable conference room should account for the required engineering work. Separate voice/video licensing from the vendor’s chat, team collaboration and AI-agent products.

The product page’s source/control positioning and pricing table’s optional source access require contract-level clarification. No concurrency, media quality, notification reliability, recording storage, security configuration, licence transfer or production recovery was tested. An advertised healthcare use case does not establish compliance of a customer-built application.
sections.zh:
构建自有通信体验的团队可评估自托管 SDK；希望立即获得会议室的非技术组织者，应计入必要工程工作。语音/视频许可应与厂商聊天、团队协作及 AI Agent 产品区分。

产品页的源码/控制权定位与价格表的可选源码访问需在合同层面明确。本次未测试并发、媒体质量、通知可靠性、录制存储、安全配置、许可转移或生产恢复。医疗场景宣传不能确立客户自建应用合规。

research_gaps.en: Platform quickstarts were not executed; numeric quote, exact source rights, deployment capacity and security remain unverified.
